title: Great service
text: Great service. Perfect replacement for my Pyrex broken lids. Thank you for carrying red lids...it's my thing😄

product_metadata.title: Pyrex 7402-PC 1113808 6-7 Cup Red Plastic Round Lid
description: The Pyrex 7402-PC red lid fits the 6/7 cup Pyrex dish. This Pyrex lid makes cooking, serving and storing convenient and easy - perfect for any occasion. This versatile Pyrex lid is safe for use in the refrigerator, freezer, or microwave and cleans up easily on the top rack of the dishwasher. Made of a non-porous surface, this lids will not absorb food odors, flavors, or stains. This lid is made in the USA and are BPA free
